understanding: Cover 8-bit divisor LSB at addr 0 and MSB at addr 1 across symbolic zero max mid values with LCR bit7 DLAB set-then-clear gating and cross of WISHBONE addr with DLAB state to prove divisor versus normal routing; INFERRED quick-test bins guide architecture only with DOCUMENTED facts as oracle.
preconditions: Clock stable at symbolic fixed period and reset completed via clock and reset without assuming polarity
Dependency t_uart_cfg programming order available for LCR DLAB set then divisor MSB-first LSB-next then DLAB clear [f_prog_msb_first f_prog_dlab_set f_prog_dlab_clear]
wishbone_bus owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i and observes wb_dat_o wb_ack_o as WISHBONE responder access
Bus addresses are 3-bit wb_adr_i pin values 0 for LSB DIV and 1 for MSB DIV with LCR at 3 [f_div_lsb_addr f_div_msb_addr]
DLAB is LCR bit 7 with 1 divisor and 0 normal and blocks opposite mapping at 0 to 1 [f_dlab_one f_dlab_zero f_dlab_gates_div f_dlab_blocks_norm]
Reset state divisor zero and LCR DLAB 0 [f_div_reset_zero f_lcr_reset]
TESTBENCH limits drain_cycles and request_timeout_cycles are symbolic operational limits only
stimulus_steps: FOR each symbolic divisor corner in DIV_ZERO DIV_MAX DIV_MID_LOW DIV_MID_HIGH do divisor-gated writes via wishbone_bus only
WRITE LCR at wb_adr_i 3 with DLAB 1 via wishbone_bus driver to select divisor [f_dlab_one f_prog_dlab_set]
WRITE divisor MSB at wb_adr_i 1 then LSB at wb_adr_i 0 MSB-first LSB-next via wishbone_bus for current corner [f_div_msb_addr f_div_lsb_addr f_prog_msb_first]
WRITE LCR at wb_adr_i 3 with DLAB 0 via wishbone_bus to disable divisor and enable normal [f_dlab_zero f_prog_dlab_clear]
IF exercising gating THEN WRITE READ normal regs at wb_adr_i 0 to 1 with DLAB 0 and divisor at wb_adr_i 0 to 1 with DLAB 1 via wishbone_bus [f_dlab_blocks_norm f_dlab_gates_div]
WAIT wb_ack_o assertion per transfer as transfer completion without assuming DUT timing
coverage_steps: SAMPLE cg_divisor_latch via dedicated subscriber tapping wishbone_bus monitor on completed divisor write with DLAB 1 [f_dlab_gates_div f_div_lsb_addr f_div_msb_addr]
SAMPLE div_lsb_value bins zero max mid_low mid_high via subscriber using observed wb_dat_i at addr 0 with DLAB 1 symbolic DIV_ZERO DIV_MAX DIV_MID values
SAMPLE div_msb_value bins zero max mid mid_high via subscriber using observed wb_dat_i at addr 1 with DLAB 1
SAMPLE cross_wb_dlab via dedicated subscriber tapping wishbone_bus monitor on wb_ack_o assertion with DLAB state [f_dlab_one f_dlab_zero f_dlab_blocks_norm]
SAMPLE wb_addr_x_dlab bins normal_0_dlab0 normal_1_dlab0 divlsb_0_dlab1 divmsb_1_dlab1 other_2to6_dlab0 other_2to6_dlab1 using wb_adr_i pin value and LCR bit7 state
NEVER sample coverage from driver items and never compare config writes as payload
completion: WAIT all spawned wishbone_bus divisor sequences complete OR UNTIL TESTBENCH request_timeout_cycles expires as operational limit only
DRAIN wishbone_bus monitor for drain_cycles as TESTBENCH operational limit then close virtual sequence
CLEANUP deassert wb_stb_i and wb_cyc_i via wishbone_bus driver and return wishbone_bus to idle leaving serial_data and modem_control_if untouched

facts.statement: Divisor Latch LSB is 8-bit RW at WISHBONE address 0.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor Latch MSB is 8-bit RW at WISHBONE address 1.
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor latches are accessible when LCR bit 7 DLAB is 1.
facts.quote: The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set

facts.statement: Normal registers at addresses 0 to 1 are inaccessible while DLAB is 1.
facts.quote: At this time the above registers at addresses 0-1 can’t be accessed.

facts.statement: LCR bit 7 value 1 selects divisor latch access.
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The divisor latches can be accessed

facts.statement: LCR bit 7 value 0 selects normal register access.
Divisor Latch register is set to 0 upon reset.
facts.quote: • The Divisor Latch register is set to 0.

facts.statement: Proper divisor programming is MSB first LSB next.
facts.quote: • Set the Divisor Latches, MSB first, LSB next.

facts.statement: Proper operation sets LCR bit 7 to 1 to allow divisor latch access.
facts.quote: to allow access to the Divisor Latches.

facts.statement: Proper operation clears LCR bit 7 to 0 to disable divisor latch access.
facts.quote: • Set bit 7 of LCR to ‘0’ to disable access to Divisor Latches.

facts.statement: LCR reset value is 00000011b with DLAB 0.
